name: Ashen Reach
blurb: A scorched, dried-out overworld: lowered seas, cinder flats, and rare humid oasis pockets scattered by seed.

ashen_reach:cinder_flats._comment: hot, near-rainless basalt plains — the pack's signature ground

ashen_reach:oasis_verge._comment: the green rim the humidity brushes carve out of the ash

field_mods._why: a guaranteed survivable pocket where the player lands
seed-scattered oases — same spots for every peer of a seed
roaming heat blooms that push weather toward dust and shimmer
